title: Digital Lab: Engineering agents that reason, act, and adapt
description:
Lost in San Francisco with a deadline to make it to Build, you’ll code an AI agent using Foundry Agent Service, Foundry IQ, and Foundry Tools. Step by step, you’ll design an agent that reasons, acts, and adapts in real time—integrating MCP tools to solve challenges along the way. Leave with hands‑on experience building and orchestrating production‑ready agentic systems.

This is a self-paced, digitally-delivered lab experience that you complete on your own schedule. Click the 'Launch' button to start the lab, and then after authentication, follow the instructions listed on the lab page to complete the activity. For technical issues or support, please contact the support team via this link: https://skill.info/build26labsupport.
